entities.name: Boris Kalin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Boris Kalin was a Slovene sculptor. He mainly created classical figures, public monuments, and nudes. Some of his sculptures are kept at Brdo Castle as part of its collection of modern Slovene art.
